approximation: Order 9 in final panel, K=4, order^2 bivariate nodes per component and K^2*order^2 density evaluations per target action. This is not exact mixture entropy/EIG. Negative approximation values are preserved. Nuisance zero-information score is analytic.

assessment.comparison_unit: Paired latent world; final IG-minus-control raw differences and 1000 fixed-seed percentile bootstrap draws. No multiplicity correction; exploratory only.
assessment.curve: After every paid observation including both common-prefix observations; never used to choose actions.
falsification: No broad advantage if the fixed space-filling control matches or beats IG on external queries.
No adequacy claim when normalized class confidence is high but query error or coverage is poor.
No query-efficiency claim based only on acquisition surrogate values.
No compression claim without the full packaged decoder/runtime boundary.
assessment.interval_method: SciPy normal CDF with 48 bisections of marginal mixture CDF, component brackets +/-12 sigma. Finite numerical equal-tail quantiles, without post-hoc calibration.
metrics: Clean mean squared error per coordinate
Full joint mixture negative log likelihood on independent noisy query pairs
Marginal equal-tail 95% mixture interval coverage and width on independent noisy queries
All-component inadequacy alarm rate and false reassurance
Retained analytic posterior bytes and audit bytes
assessment.omitted_class: Circle plus compact sin^2 window on t in (0.35,0.95), multiplied by (1.5 sin(7 pi t), 0.7 cos(5 pi t)). The menu has no such exception term. Common prefix lies outside this window.

common_owner_seam: OwnerBoundAcquisition accepts the actual existing LiveSituation/SharedOwnerRef, pins owner object and complete mechanism hashes, shares execution accounting, replays factual Events, and retains the analytic parameter posterior as explicit side state. The standalone numerical panel sets shared_owner_bound=false; owner integration is contract-tested without claiming neural transfer.
cost_boundary: All selection, analytic update, hypothetical prediction, external evaluation and checkpoint writing occurs inside the charged child process. Full source decoder bytes, retained side-state bytes and raw audit artifact bytes are distinct. Python/NumPy/SciPy/Torch shared runtime installation bytes are not counted as a self-contained packaged decoder.
diagnostic: Before each target update compute each component residual chi-square(df=2) survival probability using full predictive covariance. Alarm iff all are below 0.001. Nuisance does not trigger target inadequacy. This is a prequential, uncorrected repeated-test diagnostic, not P(outside-menu) and not an extrapolation guarantee.
durability: Atomic per-step policy checkpoint, assessor-only potential outcomes before policy execution, source copies, frozen protocol, full candidate score vectors, before-observation hypothetical branch, every joint parameter posterior/covariance and independent raw prediction/evaluation vector. Partial checkpoints remain if hard timeout prevents manifest completion.

execution_caps.memory_metric: Windows Job Object peak committed bytes, not RSS; root launcher working set reported separately

assumptions: Supplied phase t and permitted grid.
Known Gaussian observation variances and known nuisance-channel zero design.
Finite fixed generator menu with isotropic coefficient priors.
Independent observation noise conditional on the latent world.
model.joint_likelihood_status: Enhanced acquisition implementation; GG-P0 core marginal predictive metrics are not retroactively relabeled joint likelihood.
model.mathematical_object: M in {circle, ellipse, line, radial_orbit}; theta_M ~ N(0, 4 I); y_a | M,theta ~ N(A_M(a) theta, variance(a) I_2). Full joint two-coordinate class likelihood and coefficient covariance are retained.
not_claimed: Posterior probability that the menu is adequate

observation_contract: Every policy receives the same permitted finite action grid, known likelihood metadata, and total unit-cost observation budget including the common prefix. Each chosen nuisance pair consumes one observation. No action repeats. Hypothetical branches use predictive means for illustration only and contribute zero factual observations.

policy_definitions.disagreement: Maximize posterior-weighted squared distance of class predictive means from mixture mean divided by unit cost. Analytic; no entropy quadrature charged.
policy_definitions.information_gain: Maximize approximate I(Y_a;(M,theta_M)|observed events) = H(mixture predictive)-H(observation noise), using deterministic tensor Gauss-Hermite quadrature; retains raw class and within-class parameter contributions.
policy_definitions.predictive_entropy: Maximize raw full predictive Gaussian-mixture differential entropy divided by unit cost; includes aleatoric nuisance entropy.
policy_definitions.random: Uniform over the entire remaining target+nuisance grid without replacement, independent RNG seed assigned by replicate before execution.
policy_definitions.space_filling: Maximize distance from already observed target coordinates among remaining target actions, using public zero-design channel metadata; deterministic lowest-index tie break.

private_boundary: Assessor seeds, true family, true coefficients, unchosen potential observations and independent queries remain evaluator-only. Observed Event provenance record IDs contain only the public action index. choose() receives Posterior, policy name, independent policy RNG, quadrature order and resource deadline only.
process_boundary: Trusted research subprocess supervision. Child starts suspended and joins a kill-on-close Windows Job Object before running. Running supervisor enforces process-tree wall deadline; full reservation remains charged if its parent is externally interrupted. This is not a hostile-code sandbox. Supervisor startup, research labor and energy are excluded from measured child runtime.
question: Under a supplied-phase finite linear-Gaussian generator menu, do fixed information-gain acquisitions improve independent target prediction at the same paid observation budget, and where does the menu-inadequacy diagnostic fail?
replay: Fresh process replays every selected action and candidate score, branch factual-parent hash, observed event update, posterior, independent prediction vector, interval/NLL vector and summary exactly; all recorded artifact hashes verified. Wall-time fields are measured artifacts rather than recomputed equality targets.
result_driven_motivation: GG-P0 exception predictions failed on an unseen arc while the local residual guard did not fire. ACT therefore preserves the shared short-prefix condition, a localized omitted generator, and independent error/coverage curves; within-menu confidence and acquisition scores are not adequacy evidence.
seed_rule: Environment seeds and policy seeds are independently enumerated in disjoint phase namespaces. Policy RNG is keyed by phase/fixed-policy/policy and the independent replicate policy seed; family and environment seed are absent. Paired policies observe identical potential outcomes for each common selected action.
